news.analysis: Goff and the Lions made short work of the Patriots, who lost Drake Maye to an ankle injury during the first quarter. Two of Goff's touchdowns went to Amon-Ra St. Brown while the third went to Isaac TeSlaa. Goff has now thrown for 18 touchdowns and four interceptions in nine games this year. He will now head back to the US to take on the Buccaneers in Week 11.
news.contents: Jared Goff completed 20 of his 31 passes for 303 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding a three-yard run in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich, Germany in Week 10.
news.title: Jared Goff throws three TDs in Week 10 win

news.contents: Across eight games in 2026, Detroit Lions quarterback Jared Goff has completed 67.8% of his pass attempts for 2,134 yards, 15 touchdowns, and two interceptions. While Goff's numbers for the year remain strong, he's recorded back-to-back weeks with fewer than 180 passing yards and an interception. In Week 10, the 32-year-old will have a chance to bounce back against the New England Patriots. news.title: Jared Goff Looking to Bounce Back in Week 10
